chunks.head: abstain from
chunks.note: abstain from + 名词/动名词，指有意克制、不去做某事，常用于烟酒等。
chunks.ex_en: The doctor told him to abstain from sugar for a month.
chunks.ex_cn: 医生叫他一个月内忌糖。

chunks.head: find out
chunks.note: 指经过了解或探究后得知某事，强调“查出”结果。
chunks.ex_en: I want to find out who broke the window.
chunks.ex_cn: 我想弄清楚是谁打碎了窗户。

chunks.head: give up
chunks.note: give sth up，把宾语放在中间也可（give it up）；指停止做某事或放弃某个念头。

chunks.head: be concerned about
chunks.note: concerned about = 为…担忧、上心；about 后接所担心的事。
chunks.ex_en: The teacher was concerned about the sick student.
chunks.ex_cn: 老师很担心那个生病的学生。

chunks.head: hand in
chunks.note: 把文件、作业、辞呈等正式交出去。本章 Tom 递交辞呈（handed in his resignation）。
chunks.ex_en: Please hand in your homework before Friday.

chunks.head: at once
chunks.note: 表示毫不拖延、当即去做。另有“同时”一义，本章为“立刻”。

chunks.head: to one's surprise
chunks.note: 常作插入语，引出出乎意料的事；同类还有 to one's joy / to one's dismay。
chunks.ex_en: To my surprise, the old radio still worked.
chunks.ex_cn: 令我吃惊的是，那台旧收音机居然还能用。

chunks.head: make a sensation
chunks.note: sensation 此处指“轰动、大受关注的事物”；make a sensation = 引发一阵轰动。

literal.note_cn: 此处非“感觉”，指“轰动效应”

chunks.ex_en: The new singer made a sensation at the show.
chunks.ex_cn: 那位新歌手在演出上引起了轰动。

chunks.head: get up
chunks.note: 本章非“起床”义，而是“张罗、办起来”，如组队表演、搞一场演出。

literal.note_cn: 此处指“组织、筹办”，非“起床”

chunks.ex_en: The kids got up a little concert for their parents.
chunks.ex_cn: 孩子们为父母办了一场小型音乐会。

chunks.head: hope against hope
chunks.gloss: 仍抱一线希望；不死心地指望
chunks.note: 指明知希望渺茫却依然抱着希望。
chunks.ex_en: She kept hoping against hope that he would call.
chunks.ex_cn: 她仍不死心地盼着他会打来电话。

chunks.head: call one's attention to
chunks.gloss: 使某人注意到；提醒某人留意
chunks.note: 把某人的注意力引向某事物，即“提请某人注意”。
chunks.ex_en: The guide called our attention to the old painting.
chunks.ex_cn: 导游提请我们注意那幅古画。

chunks.head: by and by
chunks.note: 略显old-fashioned的说法，意为过一段时间之后。

literal.note_cn: 单独无实义，须整体记忆

chunks.ex_en: By and by, the noise died down and everyone slept.
chunks.ex_cn: 过了一会儿，喧闹平息，大家都睡了。
